GRADE 8 SOCIAL STUDIES — TERM 2 EXAM

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Time: 40 minutes

INSTRUCTIONS
1. Answer all questions.
2. Use neat handwriting.
2. For multiple choice, write the correct letter only.
3. For short answers, write clearly in the spaces provided.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A: Multiple Choice

1. About Population Growth in Africa in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore causes and effects of population growth in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Growth in Africa completely.
   C. Population Growth in Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Growth in Africa.

2. About Population Growth in Africa around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. examine types and effects of migration in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Growth in Africa completely.
   C. Population Growth in Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Growth in Africa.

3. About Population Growth in Africa in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate demographic trends in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Population Growth in Africa completely.
   C. Population Growth in Africa is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Population Growth in Africa.

5. About Diversity and interpersonal skills in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. explore social cultural diversities in Kenya,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal skills completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal skills.

6. About Diversity and interpersonal skills around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. explain ways of building a healthy self- esteem in diverse social cultural society,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal skills completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal skills.

7. About Diversity and interpersonal skills in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the impact of emotions on self and others,
   B. Learners should ignore Diversity and interpersonal skills completely.
   C. Diversity and interpersonal skills is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Diversity and interpersonal skills.

9. About Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. identify situations that lead to conflicts in the family,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration completely.
   C. Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

10. About Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. apply peaceful ways of resolving conflicts in the family,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration completely.
   C. Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

11. About Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. design strategies for effective communication in resolving conflicts,
   B. Learners should ignore Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration completely.
   C. Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.

13. About Map Reading and Interpretation in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. interpret maps using marginal information,
   B. Learners should ignore Map Reading and Interpretation completely.
   C. Map Reading and Interpretation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Map Reading and Interpretation.

14. About Map Reading and Interpretation around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. calculate areas of places on a topographical map,
   B. Learners should ignore Map Reading and Interpretation completely.
   C. Map Reading and Interpretation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Map Reading and Interpretation.

15. About Map Reading and Interpretation in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. describe the different methods of representing physical features on topographical maps,
   B. Learners should ignore Map Reading and Interpretation completely.
   C. Map Reading and Interpretation is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Map Reading and Interpretation.

17. About Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain in your school compound, which statement is correct?
   A. examine factors influencing climate in Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain completely.
   C. Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

18. About Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain around your home, which statement is correct?
   A. illustrate distribution and characteristics of major climatic regions of Africa,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain completely.
   C. Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

19. About Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain in your county, which statement is correct?
   A. explore positive ways of managing disaster-related stress,
   B. Learners should ignore Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain completely.
   C. Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain is only useful outside Kenya.
   D. There is no need to practise Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain.

SECTION B: Short Answers

4. Give two examples of how you can use Population Growth in Africa in your school compound.

8. Give two examples of how you can use Diversity and interpersonal skills in your school compound.

12. Give two examples of how you can use Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration in your school compound.

16. Give two examples of how you can use Map Reading and Interpretation in your school compound.

20. Give two examples of how you can use Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain in your school compound.
